notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 order-type control surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies prospective default attribute order, per-instance attribute-order override, interaction order control, timestamped update and interaction delivery, receive-order callback behavior, and standard time-role boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attribute and interaction order-type controls with logical-time advancement and FederateAmbassador delivery callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador order-control and time-management declarations
